description: Risk rating of a BNB Chain token from AAA to C (SCAM for confirmed scam patterns, D after a rug pull), with risk flags, simulated buy/sell taxes, who controls the contract and the liquidity, the creator history and, after a collapse, the forensics of who took the money out. A token whose markets the radar cannot read (no pool with real liquidity in BNB, USDT, USDC, FDUSD or the other supported bases) is not rated: rating is null and notRated says why. Ratings measure structural risk, not price potential. Not financial advice.
